name: Data Converter
description: Convert anything in one DBX workbench panel: 13 formats (JSON / YAML / XML / Properties / TOML / INI / .env / CSV / TSV / Query / Headers / Cookie / HTML) in any combination, batch text to SQL (IN / NOT IN / INSERT), .xlsx / .csv / .tsv to JSON, and Image ⇄ Base64. A Code Gen page turns a JSON sample or a CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python models. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: 0.1.5 (update): the Convert page now handles 13 formats in any source/target combination — TOML, INI, .env, CSV, TSV, query strings, HTTP headers, cookie strings and HTML tables join JSON / YAML / XML / Properties. TOML understands tables, arrays of tables, inline tables, dotted keys, multi-line strings and datetimes; CSV / TSV flatten nested JSON to address.city and read back into nesting plus numbers and booleans; query strings turn repeated keys into arrays, header parsing skips request/status lines, and HTML objects round-trip through tables. A Code Gen page and an Image ⇄ Base64 page round out the panel. All six pages are translated into 14 languages, and everything runs locally: no network, no eval, with hard limits on size, rows and columns.
